meta.escopo: POST /nfse/dps — required fields plus everything present in the sample payloads (2026-08-10 and the authorized issue of 2026-08-18)
meta.objetivo: Single source of the Portuguese-to-English mapping. The node properties are GENERATED from this file, not hand-written. Reviewable by a tax specialist without reading TypeScript.

convencoes.chave: Full JSON path in the issue payload.
convencoes.displayName: Label shown in the node UI. Must be in English (n8n verification).
convencoes.name: Internal parameter name in n8n, English camelCase. See 'questaoAberta' below.
convencoes.ptName: The field's original name in the API. It goes into the description and is the key that maps an API error back to the field.
convencoes.fill: Who supplies the value: 'node' (filled automatically, never exposed), 'credential', 'user', 'template' (service template), 'api' (injected by the API from the company registration).
convencoes.section: UI grouping. Sections other than 'core' sit behind a toggle.
convencoes.optionsPendentes: Marks an enum whose set of values has not been extracted from the swagger yet. Do NOT invent values.

meta.questaoAberta: n8n verification requires parameter names in English. It is not clear whether that reaches the internal 'name' (visible only in expressions) or only 'displayName'. This file uses English for 'name' to be safe, keeping 'ptName' for traceability and error mapping.
naoEnviar: infDPS.serie and infDPS.nDPS — numbering, comes from the company configuration
infDPS.prest.regTrib.opSimpNac and .regEspTrib — injected by the API from the registration
infDPS.serv.locPrest.cLocPrestacao — injected from the provider's municipality
infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.pAliq, vBC, vISSQN, vLiq — the city or provider calculates these

provedor.name: provider
provedor.description: Integration standard used to reach the city hall. Defaults to the national standard (provedor).
provedor.optionsPendentes: 'nacional' is the only value seen in a real payload. Confirm the others and when each applies.

ambiente.name: environment
ambiente.description: Target environment (ambiente). Must match what the company has configured for NFS-e — readable at GET /empresas/{cnpj}/nfse.
ambiente.nota: Passed by the caller, not derived from the credential: one credential serves N companies and each carries its own environment in its registration. The node transcribes it into infDPS.tpAmb (producao=1, homologacao=2). The base URL still comes from the credential — the host is where the API lives, the environment is data of the request (prod.acbr.api.br does serve ambiente=homologacao). Defaults to homologacao, erring on the safe side. Many municipalities have no staging at all, which is the X999 error.

referencia.name: externalReference
referencia.description: Your own identifier for this invoice (referencia). Returned by Get and List, so it links the invoice back to your records without a local table.
referencia.nota: This is the idempotency key. The API enforces uniqueness (blocked while processando, autorizada and cancelada; released after a processing error) and ListarNfse accepts it as a filter, which is what makes the replay possible. Generate it ONCE and reuse it on every retry — never regenerate. Recommended shape: a deterministic business key with an attempt suffix, e.g. '{contract_id}-2026-08' and '-r2' when reissuing after a cancellation.

infDPS.tpAmb.name: environmentCode
infDPS.tpAmb.description: Environment code inside the DPS (tpAmb). Derived from the credential environment.
infDPS.tpAmb.nota: Confirmed: 2 = staging (ambGer 2 in the authorized XML). Not exposed to the user.

infDPS.dhEmi.name: issuedAt
infDPS.dhEmi.description: Issue timestamp (dhEmi), ISO 8601 with timezone offset. Filled with the current time.

infDPS.verAplic.name: applicationVersion
infDPS.verAplic.description: Identifier of the application issuing the invoice (verAplic).
infDPS.verAplic.nota: Identifies the connector with a SHORT token, e.g. 'n8n-acbrapi/<version>', which gives ACBr server-side adoption measurement. The package name (@projetoacbr/n8n-nodes-acbrapi) does not fit: this is a fiscal field with a length limit. For reference, the authorizer uses 'SefinNacional_1.6.0' (19 characters).

infDPS.dCompet.name: servicePeriod
infDPS.dCompet.description: Date the service was rendered (dCompet), format YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

infDPS.prest.CNPJ.name: providerCnpj
infDPS.prest.CNPJ.description: Tax ID (CNPJ) of the company issuing the invoice. Must already be registered under your ACBr API tenant, with a certificate and NFS-e settings.
infDPS.prest.CNPJ.nota: PER EXECUTION, not per credential. A software house tenant serves N companies with the same credential, so this field is what selects which one is issuing — it is what lets the connector orchestrate a multi-company product. Mutually exclusive alternative: infDPS.prest.CPF.

infDPS.prest.CPF.name: providerCpf
infDPS.prest.CPF.description: Individual tax ID (CPF) of the provider, when the provider is a person rather than a company. Mutually exclusive with the company tax ID.

infDPS.toma.CNPJ.name: customerCnpj
infDPS.toma.CNPJ.description: Customer company tax ID (CNPJ). Use the Consult CNPJ operation to fill the remaining customer fields from it.
infDPS.toma.CNPJ.nota: For a company this is the only datum the user has to supply — ConsultarCnpj returns the name and the address.

infDPS.toma.CPF.name: customerCpf
infDPS.toma.CPF.description: Customer individual tax ID (CPF). Mutually exclusive with the customer company tax ID.
infDPS.toma.CPF.nota: There is no lookup by CPF — for an individual the name and address have to be supplied.

infDPS.toma.end.endNac.cMun.name: customerCityCode
infDPS.toma.end.endNac.cMun.description: IBGE code of the customer city (cMun), 7 digits. The Consult Address by Postal Code operation returns it.

infDPS.toma.end.endNac.CEP.name: customerPostalCode
infDPS.toma.end.endNac.CEP.description: Customer postal code (CEP), digits only. Use the Consult Address by Postal Code operation to fill street, district and city from it.

infDPS.toma.fone.name: customerPhone
infDPS.toma.fone.description: Customer phone number (fone), digits only including area code.

infDPS.toma.email.name: customerEmail
infDPS.toma.email.description: Customer email address (email). The API does not send email for NFS-e — use your own email node with the returned PDF.

infDPS.serv.cServ.cTribNac.name: nationalServiceCode
infDPS.serv.cServ.cTribNac.description: National service taxation code (cTribNac): 6 digits, from the service list of Complementary Law 116/2003, written without separators (item + sub-item + breakdown, so 14.02.01 becomes 140201). It decides how the city taxes the service, so the wrong code produces a valid invoice with the wrong tax. There is no lookup endpoint - find the code for your service in the official list at gov.br/nfse, or ask your accountant.
infDPS.serv.cServ.cTribNac.nota: There is no lookup endpoint. The table ships with the node and is refreshed from a static JSON. A searchable resource locator, because of the size of the list.

infDPS.serv.cServ.xDescServ.name: serviceDescription
infDPS.serv.cServ.xDescServ.description: Free-text description of the service rendered (xDescServ). Appears on the invoice.

infDPS.serv.cServ.cTribMun.name: municipalServiceCode
infDPS.serv.cServ.cTribMun.description: City-specific service code (cTribMun). Required by some cities — check the city metadata.
infDPS.serv.cServ.cTribMun.nota: Absent from the authorized issue of 2026-08-18, so optional in the national standard. Per-municipality requirements still to be mapped.

infDPS.valores.vServPrest.vServ.name: serviceAmount
infDPS.valores.vServPrest.vServ.description: Amount charged for the service (vServ), in BRL with 2 decimal places.

infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.tribISSQN.name: serviceTaxTreatment
infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.tribISSQN.description: How the municipal service tax applies to this operation (tribISSQN).
infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.tribISSQN.optionsPendentes: Only the value 1 has been seen in a real issue. The others (export, non-incidence, immunity, suspension) must come from the swagger with their exact codes. Do NOT invent them.

infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.tpRetISSQN.name: serviceTaxWithholding
infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.tpRetISSQN.description: Whether the municipal service tax is withheld, and by whom (tpRetISSQN).
infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.tpRetISSQN.optionsPendentes: Only the value 1 has been seen. Confirm the withholding codes for the customer and for the intermediary. Do NOT invent them.

infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.cLocIncid.name: taxingCityCode
infDPS.valores.trib.tribMun.cLocIncid.description: IBGE code of the city where the service tax is due (cLocIncid). Defaults to the provider city.

infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.vTotTrib.vTo.name: estimatedMunicipalTaxes
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.vTotTrib.vTo.description: Estimated total municipal taxes shown on the invoice for consumer transparency (vTotTribMun).

infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.vTotTrib.vTo.name: estimatedFederalTaxes
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.vTotTrib.vTo.description: Estimated total federal taxes shown on the invoice for consumer transparency (vTotTribFed).

infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.vTotTrib.vTo.name: estimatedStateTaxes
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.vTotTrib.vTo.description: Estimated total state taxes shown on the invoice for consumer transparency (vTotTribEst).

infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.pTotTrib.pTo.name: estimatedFederalTaxPercent
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.pTotTrib.pTo.description: Approximate total federal taxes as a percentage (pTotTribFed), per Lei 12.741/2012. Required when sending percentages instead of amounts.

infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.pTotTrib.pTo.name: estimatedStateTaxPercent
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.pTotTrib.pTo.description: Approximate total state taxes as a percentage (pTotTribEst), per Lei 12.741/2012. Required when sending percentages instead of amounts.

infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.pTotTrib.pTo.name: estimatedMunicipalTaxPercent
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.pTotTrib.pTo.description: Approximate total municipal taxes as a percentage (pTotTribMun), per Lei 12.741/2012. Required when sending percentages instead of amounts.

infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.indTotTrib.name: showEstimatedTaxes
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.indTotTrib.description: Whether estimated total taxes are stated on the invoice (indTotTrib).
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.indTotTrib.optionsPendentes: P-06 — valor 0 observado. Confirmar o conjunto completo.
infDPS.valores.trib.totTrib.indTotTrib.nota: The whole TotTrib block is mandatory, contrary to what 'required: false' suggests: without it the API returns 400 ValidationFailed / ValueRequired — "O campo 'InfDPS.Valores.Trib.TotTrib' é obrigatório" (seen on 2026-08-24). Sending indTotTrib = 0 satisfies the requirement without declaring any amounts. Revisit whether the 'totalTaxes' section should stay behind a toggle. TotTrib accepts three mutually exclusive shapes: vTotTrib (amounts), pTotTrib (percentages) or indTotTrib = 0. Sending more than one is ambiguous — pick one.

infDPS.IBSCBS.finNFSe.name: invoicePurpose
infDPS.IBSCBS.finNFSe.description: Purpose of the invoice for the new consumption tax regime (finNFSe).

infDPS.IBSCBS.indFinal.name: endConsumer
infDPS.IBSCBS.indFinal.description: Whether the customer is an end consumer (indFinal).

infDPS.IBSCBS.cIndOp.name: operationIndicatorCode
infDPS.IBSCBS.cIndOp.description: Operation indicator code for the new consumption tax regime (cIndOp).

infDPS.IBSCBS.indDest.name: recipientIndicator
infDPS.IBSCBS.indDest.description: Recipient indicator for the new consumption tax regime (indDest).

infDPS.IBSCBS.valores.trib.gIBSCBS.CST.name: taxSituationCode
infDPS.IBSCBS.valores.trib.gIBSCBS.CST.description: Tax situation code for IBS and CBS (CST).

infDPS.IBSCBS.valores.trib.gIBSCBS.cClas.name: taxClassificationCode
infDPS.IBSCBS.valores.trib.gIBSCBS.cClas.description: Tax classification code for IBS and CBS (cClassTrib).

auto.nota: Filled in by the node, never rendered.

ibscbs.nota: Optional today; required as the tax reform advances.

cancellation.nota: Empty means no body on the request.

resposta.nota: Response of POST /nfse/dps. The API is asynchronous: the id always comes back immediately, and everything that follows is tracked with it.

id.description: ACBr API identifier for the invoice (id), prefixed 'nfs_'. Use it to check status and download files.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the API accepted the request.

status.nota: Loop rule: keep going WHILE status == 'processando'; any other value is terminal, with the reason in 'mensagens'. A whitelist of what continues, not of what ends — so an unknown or future state stops the loop instead of spinning forever. Poll with GET /nfse/{id}, never with Sincronizar, which charges one credit.

numero.description: Invoice number assigned by the city hall (numero). Only present once authorized.
numero.nota: Assigned only on authorization — FIFO processing, no risk of collision.

codigo_verificacao.description: Official verification code of the invoice (codigo_verificacao). Together with the number, this is what your records should store.

link_url.description: Official public page where the invoice can be viewed and verified (link_url).
link_url.nota: Prefer this link over the PDF in notification flows: lighter, it is the official page, and it sidesteps the question of credit consumption on the PDF download.

data_emissao.description: Timestamp when the invoice was authorized (data_emissao).

ambiente.description: Environment the invoice was issued in.

referencia.description: The external reference sent in the request, echoed back. Links the invoice to your own records.
referencia.nota: Bound to the nfs_ id. This is the idempotency key.

DPS.description: Service declaration data, including the series and number assigned by the API (serie, nDPS). Empty while the invoice is still processing.
DPS.nota: Confirms that the numbering is injected by the API from the company configuration.

mensagens.description: Messages returned by the city hall, including rejection reasons.
mensagens.nota: Surface this to the user on a rejection — it carries the reason.

erros.nota: Maps the API's Portuguese error messages to the English text shown to the node's user. Key: the code plus an identifying fragment of the message.

referenciaDuplicada.displayMessage: An invoice with this external reference was already issued.
referenciaDuplicada.descricaoTratamento: Do NOT propagate as a failure. Fetch the invoice already issued under this 'referencia' and return it as the result, flagged alreadyIssued: true. Propagating the error makes the user reissue under a different 'referencia' and produces exactly the duplicate the constraint prevents.
referenciaDuplicada.comoLocalizar: GET /nfse (ListarNfse) filtering by cpf_cnpj + ambiente + referencia. The node already holds the first two.
referenciaDuplicada.nota: Covers all three states, pending included, so it covers the most common retry case. Related rule: generate the 'referencia' once and reuse it on every retry, never regenerate. The original message leaks the internal type 'Nfse.Entities.TNfseEntity'; do not pass it on to the user.

x999SemHomologacao.apiMessagePt: X999: Erro de Conexão: Não informado a URL de Homologação
x999SemHomologacao.displayMessage: This city has no staging environment. Switch the credential to production to test with this city.
x999SemHomologacao.nota: Expected to be common — few of the municipal providers keep a staging environment.

escopoAusente.displayMessage: Your credential is missing the '{escopo}' scope. Edit the ACBr API credential and enable it.
escopoAusente.descricaoTratamento: The node knows which scope each operation requires, so it should name it in the message instead of passing the raw 403 on. This failure mode exists because the credential selects scopes with checkboxes.

mapaOperacaoEscopo.cnpj: Consult CNPJ, List Companies by Activity Code

creditoInsuficiente.displayMessage: Not enough credits in your ACBr API account to issue this invoice.
creditoInsuficiente.nota: 402, not 403 — it is credit, not permission.

cotaExcedida.displayMessage: The request exceeds your account quota limit.

pendentes.nota: Payload blocks not mapped yet. They arrive behind a toggle and depend on the full swagger.
blocos: infDPS.valores.vDedRed — deductions and reductions (deepest block of the payload)

cancelamento.nota: No body field is mandatory in the API — only the 'id' in the path. Both are required by some city halls only. If the user fills in nothing, do NOT send a body. Consumption: 1 credit per request. Cancelling blocks reuse of the 'referencia'.

codigo.name: cancellationCode
codigo.description: Cancellation code, required by some city halls only. Accepted values come from your city hall manual — there is no global list.
codigo.nota: No enumerable list: it is per municipality, like the rest of the local requirements. A free text field, not a dropdown.

motivo.name: cancellationReason
motivo.description: Free-text cancellation reason, required by some city halls only.
